'''Faeldrin Harella''' was an [[Aes Sedai]] from the [[Green Ajah]].

== Appearance and Abilities ==
She has cool eyes and thin braids in her dark hair adorned with colored beads.{{ref/book|6|49}}{{ref/book|10|16}} She is 5'4" or 163 cm in height.{{ref|{{twotc}},Faeldrin Haralla|comp}}

==Strength and Abilities==
Faeldrin is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|strong]] for an Aes Sedai, with a strength of {{opsl|22}}.{{ref||comp}}

[[Merana Ambrey]] feels particularly self-conscious about her ranking in the [[Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn]], even though she is its appointed leader. Faeldrin, [[Masuri Sokawa]] and [[Rafela Cindal]] are the three strongest sisters in the group.{{ref/book|6|49}} She is strong enough to [[Traveling|Travel]].

==History==
Faeldrin was born in [[Tarabon]] in {{ne|937}}.{{ref||comp}}

In {{ne|952}}, she enrolled at the White Tower as a novice. She spent five years as a novice and five as Accepted. She was raised to the Green Ajah in {{ne|962}}.{{ref||comp}}

She has three Warders.{{ref/book|6|54}}

== Activities ==
After the [[White Tower Schism|White Tower schism]] she allied herself with the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]].

She was part of the [[Salidar Embassy to the Dragon Reborn|Salidar delegation]] sent to greet [[Rand al'Thor]] in [[Caemlyn]].{{ref/book|6|p}}According to Min, Faeldrin was upset that [[Dragonsworn]] had committed atrocities in her native Tarabon, as well as Altara and Murandy. She also tended to blame Dragonsworn for the chaos in Tarabon, even though it had been affected by civil war before the Dragonsworn came. After the delegation dissolved she accompanied [[Bera Harkin]] and [[Kiruna Nachiman]] to meet Rand in [[Cairhien]] after he flees [[Andor]].{{ref/book|6|49}}

She met up with the [[Two Rivers]] folks who then head to and then fight in the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]]. Afterwards she was forced to swear fealty to Rand.{{ref/book|6|55}}

She intended to keep her Oaths to the best of her ability, but could not stand up to Cadsuane.

She was part of Rand's embassy when he meets with the [[Sea Folk]] and makes the [[Bargain]].{{ref/book|7|34}}

Faeldrin and the other sworn sisters stayed for a time in Cairhien under the care of the Aiel Wise Ones.{{ref/book|8|12}}

In Far Madding Rand told Alanna to bring Faeldrin and some of the other to Haddon Mirk to start a negotiation with the rebels there.{{ref/book|9|25}}

Alanna went to Tear with Faeldrin, Merana, Bera, and Rafela.{{ref/book|9|32}} They are able to find an agreement, in fact the rebels have agreed to end the rebellion if Rand will restore their land and titles and make Darlin king of Tear.{{ref/book|11|21}}

Kiruna and Faeldrin were killed at [[Shayol Ghul]] by [[Hessalam]] while in a circle with [[Damer Flinn]], [[Sarene Nemdahl]] and [[Aviendha]] at the [[Last Battle]].{{ref/book|14|34}}

== Viewings ==
[[Min Farshaw]] sees her in Rand's hand along with four other [[Aes Sedai]], and then interprets the viewing for him: all five will keep their word.{{ref/book|7|34}}{{ref/book|9|25}}
